units.source_text: 打十三四岁起，阿泷就能骑着无鞍马跑东跑西。

en.t: From the age of thirteen or fourteen, Otaki could ride bareback all over the place.

units.source_text: 她背着满篓绿油油的山萮菜，扬鞭策马从山上飞驰而下，犹如一阵绿色的晨风。

en.t: With a basket full of fresh green wild vegetables on her back, she would crack the whip and gallop down from the mountain like a green morning breeze.
